content:
Theydies and Gentletheys,
Welcome to a time honored tradition.
The national pastime of these united colonies.


Your ball’s AC is equal to your opponents AC.

The rules. 
There are 4 rounds.
On your first turn, you attempt to hit the ball through one of two wickets. 
Either the treasure wicket for 200 gold.
Or the Monster wicket. A ball put through the monster wicket will proc a role on the wild magic table and steal half of your opponent’s accumulated stash. 
Missing the wicket means that if your opponent sinks their next shot your ball was hit and you have disadvantage on the next round.
The winner moves on to the next bracket and the loser is done. Only the champion keeps the pot. 
Should there be a tie, the gentlethey's may choose to resolve it with a coin toss or a fight to the death.
100 gold entry fee.

The Opponents must come to a gentlethey's agreement as to who the first shall be to swing their mallet.

Cheating is a well known past time. However, getting caught cheating will incur an infraction.

1st Infraction will receive a stern finger wave
2nd Infraction will demand that the offender offers a gentltheydie's apology to the victim of your shenanigans, and possibly a fine of 100 gold. If no apology is offered, the victim may demand a duel of pistols. 
If a 3rd infraction is given, A duel is compulsory. If the offender does not throw away their shot, the victim shall be awarded the use of a superior gun.


Any disputes must end in a gentlethey's accord and a gentlethey's hand shake. A gentlethey's hand shake consists of a firm but reasonable amount of pressure, three well composed shakes and firm but not unkind eye contact. It shall be followed by a shout of "Huzzah!"
